description.en: A digital medium-format camera with a built-in prime lens and an electronic viewfinder, an example of a fixed-lens mirrorless design.
description.zh-cn: 这是一台配备内置定焦镜头和电子取景器的数码中画幅相机，也是固定镜头无反相机的一个实例。

en: The built-in 35 mm f/4 lens supports autofocus and manual focus. Fixed lens describes how the lens is attached, and prime describes its single focal length.
Fujifilm lists this 35 mm lens as equivalent to 28 mm on full frame. The digital teleconverter narrows the framing by cropping. The physical focal length stays at 35 mm.
The GFX100RF and X-T5 both use electronic viewfinders and CMOS sensors. The GFX100RF has a larger recording area and a Bayer color filter array, while the X-T5 uses APS-C and an X-Trans array.
zh-cn: 这支内置 35 mm f/4 定焦镜头支持自动和手动对焦。固定镜头说的是能否更换，定焦说的是镜头只有一个焦距。
富士标注这支 35 mm 镜头的全画幅等效焦距为 28 mm。数字增距功能通过裁切收窄取景范围，镜头的实际焦距仍为 35 mm。
GFX100RF 和 X-T5 都采用电子取景器与 CMOS 传感器。GFX100RF 的成像面积更大，采用拜耳彩色滤光阵列，X-T5 则采用 APS-C 画幅和 X-Trans 阵列。
